page.overview:
Who is Mateo?

Mateo is a supporting character in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory. He is a Filipino-American Department of Prehistoric Wildlife truck driver who resigned from his job after accidentally getting Brooklynn seemingly killed.

Mateo worked as a truck driver from DPW transporting dinosaurs. During his job, a stranger told him on the phone that he could earn money in exchange for transporting dinosaurs and unloading them into another truck. Although he was getting money, Mateo hoped against hope that he wouldn't be doing any harm and desired to save up enough money for his daughter Hiraya to go to college.

When he arrived one night with an Allosaurus, he was alone with no other trucks. He found it strange and even more so when he noticed that the dinosaur he was transporting was not sedated and the lock opened on its own, freeing it. He hid in some bushes to avoid it, until the Allosaurus left upon hearing something. Mateo witnessed the dinosaur chasing Brooklynn while he was still hiding, being very shocked and scared that it was happening. As he left, he noticed blood on the road, which made him believe that the Allosaurus had killed the young woman, finding her phone ringing, just as Darius Bowman arrived. Mateo panicked and felt remorseful when he saw that he had won more money for the young woman's death.

He remained in the DPW for some time, but eventually decided to give up, feeling guilt stricken about what had happened. He set out to do the right thing and redeem himself, trying to locate the Nublar Six, and although it took him a long time, because he was not very good with the internet, he eventually found them with help from his daughter Hiraya.
